title: PULSEmech iPhone Device Transition Ledger v0
description: Closed shape contract for the synthetic and future observed PULSEmech iPhone Device Transition Ledger. Cross-record digests, contiguous ordering, identifier uniqueness, event-to-endpoint relations, coverage semantics, checkpoint closure and signatures are reconstructed by the separately implemented verifier.
$comment: Semantic verification requirements: records are ordered exactly by sequence_index, indices are contiguous from zero, record IDs are unique, the first previous_record_sha256 is null, every later previous_record_sha256 equals the immediately previous exact record digest, and record_sha256 = SHA-256(canonical JSON of the complete record excluding only record_sha256). For event-bound transitions, the source snapshot is the greatest eligible observed network snapshot before the bound event and the target snapshot is the least eligible observed network snapshot after it; the target snapshot must bind that event, no intervening network event is permitted, and one event may materialize at most one transition. For interrupted transitions, the source is the last bound snapshot before the window-close boundary and the target is the first bound snapshot after a new session has received a fresh path-update callback. Duplicate window-close callbacks do not create a second gap; disconnect is terminal and accepted once. Top-level summary and checkpoint counts, IDs and digests must be reconstructed rather than trusted.

source_interface.const: UIKit UIScene.activationState and UISceneDelegate lifecycle callbacks
